text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... The dream Grand Prix race.
The year's most popular—and inevitably most talented—
umamusume compete at the highest level.

In terms of sheer ability, Mejiro Ramonu is second to none.
Even against champions of different generations, her running will shine brightly.
—If there was just one point of concern, however.
That factor was distance... At 2,500 meters, it was longer than the mile and middle distances that Mejiro Ramonu excelled at.
choice_data_list: (Still, it's just a lack of experience.)

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's strength is the real deal.
I believe it will definitely see her through, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's nervous after all...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That look in your eyes.
I can't stand it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"...
Haven't you already watched it plenty of times?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A dreamlike race where wonderful Umamusume gather...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for what so many Umamusume strive for,
and what sets people into a frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
There is no room for fear.
Just let your heart dance with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I shall remain true
to my own love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And—
I will simply claim the results that match.
